note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Guides are written in our own words from the sources below; anything the community has not confirmed yet is labelled unconfirmed.

sources.name: Official PS5 trophy list, via Exophase / Push Square (18 Nov 2026)
GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — KeenGamer
GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements — GTAVibes
GTA 6 Achievements — GTA VI Vice City Hub

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. This pops last, once the story, 100% completion and every activity and collectible in this guide are done — roughly 200 hours in total, at a 4/10 difficulty.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks naturally as you play the first mission with Jason and Lucia.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy that pops at the end of the chapter. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy you can miss.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy — keep playing through the chapter and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy — keep playing through the chapter and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy — keep playing through the chapter and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. After the credits roll, free roam stays open, so everything else in this guide can still be finished afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story missions unlock as you play; no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion). You do not have to find everything: the checklist asks for set portions only — 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 8 bank vaults, 70 of 80 challenges, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 300 of 397 stunts, and more. See the roadmap's 100% table for the full list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts count across jumps, airtime and driving feats, so work them in while driving the story and free roam. Note: 100% completion asks for 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, drone races, fishing, bowling, arcade games, the shooting range, pool, mini-golf and basketball. One try at each is enough — you do not have to win or finish them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practise each range until gold; all 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so this is not skippable on the road to platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone time trials across those 14 spots; winning one race at each location pops this trophy, but 100% completion wants all 42 trials finished.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts. 100% completion asks for 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; fishing is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet and play it through to the end; there are four video games to try.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the strangers with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the strangers with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the strangers with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than the 8 needed, so you can skip a couple and still pop it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the strangers with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the strangers with a mission strand; follow his strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — she mentions meditating; follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Do that balcony meditation before you finish Chapter 1. The other 17 spots can be done any time, and 100% completion only needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand (his Target Deck) has 15 objectives; hunt the unique animal he marks. Studying animals with binoculars along the way also feeds the 100-animal requirement for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; 100% completion asks for 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting well past 3.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open WAiNK and scan vehicles and landmarks as you travel; start scanning new things from the beginning and the count builds naturally. 100% completion also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this overlaps fully.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span eight categories of 10 — combat, vehicle, and more — and they are all available from the start. 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so 50 is a waypoint, not the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get to 4 stars while your partner is beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row, keep your partner with you, and keep the wanted level alive between each one.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app; the count tracks the base models you have found. 100% completion wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy firefight and chain five takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a departing passenger aircraft and take off with it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Find a Rhino, steal it, and fight with it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Fencing the jewelry also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults open up during Chapter 4, when the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' unlocks them; rob any five and get away clean. 100% completion wants all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cash, and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive through every area until the map is uncovered; the WAiNK app helps you spot places you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Hit one operation per gang across Leonida; gang operations also feed the 100% checklist (39 of 39).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community — try ordering a cocktail at a bar overlooking Ocean Beach. Treat this one as unconfirmed until a trusted guide pins it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed — the description points to driving a car out through a showroom front. Check back as the community confirms it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: steal the three key valuables there and escape.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximise the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength with each character until both stats are maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Play naturally — robberies, crimes and choices all feed the profile — and the count builds toward 500 over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This hidden trophy's unlock is still unconfirmed — the community is still pinning it down. Do not trust a guide that states a method without a source.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy whose unlock is still unconfirmed — it likely involves witnessing something strange in Leonida. Still being confirmed by the community.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed; the name points to a melee drive-by takedown, likely near the bowling alley.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; fence them through contacts until $250,000 is laundered. This also counts toward the 100% checklist, which wants $250,000 of marked bills fenced.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and more — the total adds up across every shop in Leonida.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Buy garages as they become available; they also store your registered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own through the Scooter Bros app until you reach 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
